nodes.description: Address of the contract owner set in the Ownable constructor; governs all onlyOwner restricted functions.
Boolean pause flag from Pausable; blocks token transfers via whenNotPaused modifier.
ERC20 mapping of account balances, mutated by _transfer, _mint and _burn.
ERC20 nested mapping of owner to spender allowances, mutated by _approve.
Total token supply, increased by _mint and decreased by _burn.
SwivelToken constructor: sets name/symbol via ERC20 and mints 1e9 * 10**decimals to the deployer (msg.sender).
Owner-only function that triggers the paused state via _pause().
Owner-only function that returns the contract to the unpaused state via _unpause().
Owner-only privileged function that mints arbitrary amounts of new tokens to any address.
Override hook gated with whenNotPaused; called before every mint, burn and transfer.
Internal ERC20 mint: increases _totalSupply and recipient _balances, invoking the before-transfer hook.
Internal ERC20 burn: decreases account _balances and _totalSupply, invoking the before-transfer hook.
Internal ERC20 transfer: moves balances between accounts after reading the sender balance.
Internal ERC20 approve: writes the _allowances mapping for owner/spender.
Public burn of the caller's own tokens via _burn(_msgSender(), amount).
Public burn from another account using the caller allowance; reads allowance, approves reduced value and burns.
Owner-only function that reassigns the privileged _owner state variable to newOwner.
Owner-only function that sets _owner to the zero address, removing all privileged control.
View returning the current _owner address; used by the onlyOwner modifier check.
Caller address (via _msgSender) used for access-control checks and as the mint/transfer origin.
Privileged state update in _mint: _totalSupply += amount and _balances[account] += amount.
Privileged ownership state update: _owner = newOwner (and reset to address(0) on renounce).
Emergency-stop state update: _paused = true/false performed by _pause/_unpause.
Arithmetic mutation of balances and total supply (senderBalance - amount, _balances[recipient] += amount, _totalSupply +/-).
mint(address to, uint256 amount) recipient parameter.
mint(address to, uint256 amount) amount parameter.
burn(uint256 amount) amount parameter burned from the caller.
burnFrom(address account, uint256 amount) source-account parameter.
transferOwnership(address newOwner) parameter assigned into the _owner state variable.
Local cached _balances[sender] inside _transfer used for the balance require and subtraction.
Local cached _balances[account] inside _burn used for the burn require and subtraction.
Local allowance snapshot in burnFrom (and transferFrom) used for the allowance require and reduction.
Local address msgSender in the Ownable constructor, assigned as the initial _owner.

edges.reason: Deployer msg.sender is read in the constructor to mint the initial supply.
Constructor mints 1e9 * 10**decimals tokens, mutating total supply and deployer balance.
Constructor stores _msgSender() into the local msgSender variable.
Local msgSender is written into the _owner state variable during construction.
pause() is gated by onlyOwner which compares owner() with _msgSender().
unpause() is gated by onlyOwner which compares owner() with _msgSender().
mint() is privileged and only callable when msg.sender equals the stored owner.
transferOwnership() is onlyOwner; msg.sender controls the ownership variable.
renounceOwnership() is onlyOwner and can permanently clear the owner as msg.sender.
pause() delegates to the internal emergency-stop state change.
unpause() delegates to the internal emergency-stop state change.
Emergency-stop update writes the _paused state variable.
mint() forwards to the internal _mint implementation.
mint recipient parameter 'to' flows into the privileged mint entry point.
mint amount parameter flows into the privileged mint entry point, allowing arbitrary issuance.
Recipient address is propagated from mint into _mint.
Unbounded amount is propagated from mint into _mint supply arithmetic.
_mint performs the privileged supply and balance increase.
Mint supply/balance update relies on unchecked-style arithmetic on user-supplied amount.
_mint adds amount into the _balances mapping entry.
_mint increases the _totalSupply state variable by amount.
_mint invokes the _beforeTokenTransfer hook before mutating balances.
_burn invokes the _beforeTokenTransfer hook before mutating balances.
_transfer invokes the _beforeTokenTransfer hook before mutating balances.
Hook is gated by whenNotPaused, letting the owner freeze all transfers.
burn() calls the internal _burn on the caller.
burnFrom() calls the internal _burn on the target account.
burnFrom() reduces the allowance through _approve before burning.
burn amount parameter is passed to the burn entry point.
burnFrom account parameter selects whose tokens are destroyed.
Local currentAllowance caches the allowance read inside burnFrom.
currentAllowance - amount feeds the allowance write done by _approve.
_approve writes the _allowances mapping.
_transfer debits sender and credits recipient in the _balances mapping.
_transfer reads _balances[sender] into the local senderBalance.
senderBalance - amount is written back into _balances.
_burn reduces the account entry inside the _balances mapping.
_burn decreases the _totalSupply state variable.
_burn reads _balances[account] into the local accountBalance.
accountBalance - amount is written back into _balances.
onlyOwner modifier on transferOwnership reads owner() to validate msg.sender.
owner() reads the _owner state variable for the access-control check.
transferOwnership executes the privileged ownership state update.
Ownership update writes the new value into the _owner state variable.
renounceOwnership writes address(0) into the _owner state variable.
newOwner parameter flows into the ownership transfer function.
Untrusted newOwner parameter becomes the privileged owner, enabling single-step ownership takeover.
The account parameter is consumed by burnFrom to select the burn target.

normalization_plan.reason: The 'to' parameter only exists to feed the privileged mint entry point and has no independent semantic role.
The unbounded amount parameter defines the minting capability and should be folded into the mint function node.
The burn amount is a simple argument of the public burn function.
The account argument identifies the allowance owner consumed by burnFrom; fold it into burnFrom.
newOwner is the sole argument driving the privileged ownership reassignment performed by transferOwnership.
Temporary balance cache used only within the _transfer arithmetic; merge into _transfer.
Temporary balance cache used only within _burn; merge into _burn.
Allowance snapshot read computed inside burnFrom for the allowance decrement; merge into burnFrom.
Deployer address alias used only in the constructor to seed _owner; merge into constructor.
